errorTypes.name: Reference-method bias
errorTypes.definition: Systematic error of the DFT functional or reference theory itself
errorTypes.canonicalEmblem: Adsorption MUE ≈0.25 eV, best-of-six functionals vs CE39 experiment

errorTypes.name: Emulator / model-form error
errorTypes.definition: MLIP architecture or training-objective bias, incl. PES softening

errorTypes.name: Domain shift / coverage failure
errorTypes.definition: Compositions, frameworks, or configurations absent from training
errorTypes.canonicalEmblem: HEA energy errors 4–5× threshold on a classical EAM target (E7)

errorTypes.name: Numerical / sampling error
errorTypes.definition: Convergence, grid, and statistical error in labels or evaluation

errorTypes.name: Multiscale closure gap
errorTypes.definition: ps-scale MD must close to service-life evolution via surrogate models
errorTypes.canonicalEmblem: 240 ps cascade vs 5-year fusion service life (E8)
errorTypes.lever: Closure models whose parameters inherit the underlying error

errorTypes.name: Validation-data gap
errorTypes.definition: No experiment or qualified database exists at the required condition
errorTypes.canonicalEmblem: ~20 dpa qualified RAFM data vs 50 dpa DEMO requirement (E9)

errorTypes.name: Observability / experimental-reference uncertainty
errorTypes.definition: The target quantity is ill-posed, reconstructed, or inconsistently referenced
errorTypes.canonicalEmblem: 22% of OC20 relaxations reconstructed; exclusion cuts MAE ~35–39%

emblems.name: Strong correlation & self-interaction
emblems.fact: Plain DFT (U=0) gives undoped La₂CuO₄ a metallic, non-magnetic ground state; experiment: AFM charge-transfer insulator ~2 eV gap

emblems.name: Excited states & band gaps
emblems.fact: ~1 eV SOC term in Pb-halide perovskites; QSGW +15% overshoot — error cancellation masquerading as accuracy

emblems.name: Magnetism
emblems.fact: Fe₂B Tc overestimated ~35% (1,570 vs 1,013 K); Co₂B underestimated ×1.5; 15–35% sign-unstable band

emblems.name: Barrier & transition-state error
emblems.fact: 0.310–0.349 eV MAE across 574 DFT-NEB paths, ~5–6× the ~60 meV floor; CHGNet 73.1% / M3GNet 78.2% underestimated

emblems.name: PES softening & finite-T error
emblems.fact: >90% of 229 PhononDB materials softened; non-conservative models produce imaginary phonons

emblems.name: Dispersion
emblems.fact: Semi-empirical vdW corrections 0.77–3.04× RPA interlayer energies; MoS₂ surface energy 0.07–0.32 N/m across methods

emblems.name: Composition & framework coverage
emblems.fact: Five architectures cannot learn a classical five-element EAM potential; GRACE-2L 617.9 meV/atom zero-shot; CHA→MFI ≥10×

emblems.name: Multiscale closure
emblems.fact: NEP-ZBL 8.1M atoms / 240 ps vs five-year service life — >15 orders of magnitude

emblems.name: Validation-data scarcity
emblems.fact: RAFM database qualified near 20 dpa vs staged 50 dpa DEMO second blanket at 11–14 appm He/dpa

materialClasses.headlineError: Harmonic λ 2.64 vs 1.84 anharmonic on H₃S (~43% high); no generally predictive first-principles Tc method across unconventional families

materialClasses.name: Correlated oxides & quantum materials
materialClasses.headlineError: Plain DFT renders La₂CuO₄ metallic and non-magnetic; HSE vs DMC split ~1 eV on ZnO oxygen vacancy

materialClasses.name: High-entropy alloys & disorder
materialClasses.headlineError: Five architectures 4–5× the 2.5 meV/atom threshold on MS25's five-element alloy; 617.9 meV/atom zero-shot (one suite)
materialClasses.usHook: ARPA-E ULTIMATE; Co/Cr on USGS list

materialClasses.headlineError: LDA gap underestimate ~50% across a 472-material benchmark; ~1 eV error cancellation inside Pb-halide perovskite gaps

excludedClasses.name: Conventional steels, simple metals, commodity ceramics
excludedClasses.reason: Fail A1 — fixed-composition MLIPs reach ~0.2 meV/atom; constraint is manufacturing, not simulation

excludedClasses.name: Quantum-computing hype; business plan; lobbying
excludedClasses.reason: Not material classes; out of scope by genre

scoreboard.currentState: >90% of 229 benchmark materials softened; parity slopes ~0.6; 337 meV/Å force MAE (vanilla CHGNet, WS₂)
scoreboard.demonstratedFix: 1-structure scalar fine-tune −11.9–16.4%; 10-structure full −34%; 1-frame WS₂ 337→178 meV/Å; ~100 frames ~100 meV/Å; PFT −55% (single study)
scoreboard.solvedTarget: Parity slope ≥0.95; κSRME ≤0.3 (author-proposed, anchored to demonstrated values)

scoreboard.failureMode: Wrong fidelity: PBE labels where SCAN/hybrid needed
scoreboard.currentState: r2SCAN reference data ~5× costlier than PBE
scoreboard.demonstratedFix: 80% GGA + 10% SCAN multi-fidelity M3GNet ≈ model trained on 8× as many SCAN labels (Si and water); class-transfer [TRN]
scoreboard.solvedTarget: meta-GGA/hybrid fidelity at GGA data cost (engineering requirement)

scoreboard.currentState: Unphysical water–vapor interfaces, polar dimers from short-ranged MLIPs
scoreboard.demonstratedFix: Latent Ewald (LES) at ~2× cost; charges inferred from energies+forces alone
scoreboard.solvedTarget: Long-range module default in foundation MLIPs (engineering requirement)

scoreboard.demonstratedFix: Misspecification-aware UQ bounds MACE-MPA-0 errors across Materials Project; committee QbC; heterogeneous ensembles
scoreboard.solvedTarget: Achieved-coverage-calibrated error bars per observable and domain

scoreboard.currentState: Density error 5.2% vs 2.5% for the models' own DFT labels; shear-modulus error 188.6% (calcite); pressures 'poorly described'
scoreboard.demonstratedFix: Observable-first benchmarks exist and are adopted: MS25, Matbench Discovery (F1 0.931 SOTA), UniFFBench, Dyna-Mat
scoreboard.solvedTarget: Density MAPE ≤2–3%; elastic MAPE ≤10% (physical tolerance, experiment-anchored)

scoreboard.currentState: Barrier MAE 0.310–0.349 eV over 574 paths vs ~60 meV DFT-NEB reference error; MS25's 0.74 eV barrier recovered only ±0.06 eV
scoreboard.demonstratedFix: Partial levers only: classification (>82%) and path-initialization (>71%) gates; per-chemistry TS-labeled fine-tuning 0.23→0.09 eV; no cross-chemistry recipe [PRP]
scoreboard.solvedTarget: Barrier MAE ≤40 meV (≈0.92 kcal/mol) vs fixed DFT-NEB reference (author-proposed fidelity threshold)

scoreboard.demonstratedFix: Targeted high-pressure fine-tuning restores robustness; MatterSim 0–5000 K, ≤1000 GPa with uncertainty-aware active learning
scoreboard.solvedTarget: Uniform accuracy across the P–T envelope (engineering requirement)

scoreboard.currentState: Standard MLIPs blind to spin and charge state
scoreboard.demonstratedFix: SpinGNN++ sub-meV spin-lattice accuracy; LES infers charges; UMA takes spin+charge inputs

scoreboard.currentState: Adsorption MUE ≈0.25 eV best-of-six vs experiment; voltages 0.7–1 V raw GGA; OC20 consistency plateau
scoreboard.demonstratedFix: NeuralXC; DM21 (fails transition metals); Skala 2.8 kcal/mol on GMTKN55 at semi-local cost (molecules); experiment-anchored linear correction MAD 0.096 eV/atom
scoreboard.solvedTarget: XC error below chemical accuracy on solids, not only molecules (literature benchmark)

formalProof.kernelRejectedClaim: 27/36 → 26/36 at 10⁻⁴ J/m² integer precision (one cell margin exactly zero)
formalProof.barrierTheorems: Conditional: under ErrorField decomposition + coordination-ordering hypotheses, softened models provably under-read barriers; corrected barriers provably equal reference

acceptanceTests.test: Migration-barrier MAE ≤40 meV (0.922 kcal/mol) vs fixed DFT-NEB across chemistries, balanced signed errors + uncertainty budget vs experiment
Ranking-faithful magnetocrystalline anisotropy and Tc across held-out REE-free candidate set, microstructure-aware coercivity bounds
Adsorption energies within ~0.1 eV of experiment on held-out benchmark at screening cost, operando spot-validation
Energy MAE ≤2.5 meV/atom on DFT-labeled, SRO-resolved multi-composition benchmark
Scheme-consistent adsorption enthalpies within ~4 kJ/mol plus thermodynamic water-stability classification
Right gaps for the right reasons at screening cost, ±0.05 eV compositional targeting
Calibrated cascade→OKMC→rate-theory hand-off, every source term carrying a calibrated error bar, citable in a licensing case
Quantitative λ and ωlog with uncertainty (physical tolerance); superexchange J trends at cluster-DMFT fidelity (author-proposed)
Screening-capable correlated energetics with J errors bounded against neutron data
Published, third-party-reproduced prospective record: majority of delivered candidates survive synthesis
Quantitative lattice thermal conductivity with four-phonon and higher channels by default on held-out set incl. anomalous crystals

killCriteria.name: The 90:10 fidelity wedge
killCriteria.endpoint: 8×-equivalent reduction in high-fidelity labels reproduced within ±20% on two target classes by month 18
killCriteria.decisionRule: Miss on either class: endpoint recorded failed; wedge narrows to pure dataset interventions

killCriteria.name: Barrier wedge
killCriteria.endpoint: Held-out barrier MAE ≤195 meV by month 24 on two solid-electrolyte families (midpoint of 349→40 meV road)
killCriteria.decisionRule: Above threshold: stop selling barrier accuracy; publish the negative result as an MS25-style benchmark artifact

killCriteria.name: Fusion long game
killCriteria.endpoint: By 2030: uncertainty bounds envelop an ion-irradiation observable suite AND at least one lab-led consortium or milestone-company team adopts the chain
killCriteria.decisionRule: Miss either conjunct: exit Chain 7's qualification ambition; keep data-and-UQ services line
